note: forkPointSha is the merge-base of this fork and upstream when tracking started on 2026-11-16; it never moves, because the fork ports upstream changes and does not merge them. lastReviewedSha is the last upstream commit a decision log classified; only .claude/skills/upstream-review/scripts/upstream-review.sh --advance <sha> moves it, and only forward.
